assembly.boiler: Closed octagonal prism, 80×80×160 px; eight strips and two caps. Never substitute a box.
assembly.intersections: Cab overlaps boiler by 8 px; chimney embeds 1 px, dome 4 px, chassis intersects lower boiler. All solids individually closed.
assembly.moving: Parent every face to the same train root; yaw that root around train_pivot_units.
assembly.atlas: Each PNG standalone; uv_top_left coordinates refer to that full file, not a hidden atlas.
assembly.scale: At maximum expected presentation use about one art texel per logical render pixel; preview scale 0.99.
assembly.wheel_alignment: Wheel centers y=20; z=32,84,136. Rod centers in image are (32,22),(84,22),(136,22). Right side +90 degree phase per frame, left offset one frame.

running.time_note: 100 ms is preview cadence; gameplay phase = floor(distance / wheel circumference * 4) modulo 4. Both wheel and rods use same phase.
